description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Voltaic Key by paying {1}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {2}, returning Voltaic Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability instead to draw infinite cards.
